The Celtics defeated the Bucks, 109-102 tonight in Boston. Paul George finished with a team-high 25 points along with 5 assists and 5 three pointers for the Celtics, while Derrick White tallied 24 points, 7 assists and 4 rebounds in the game. Tyler Herro recorded 25 points, 5 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Celtics improve their record to 6-2 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-7 for the season.
